product.name: Monoprice Commercial Audio 120W 2ch Mixer Amp (No Logo)
product.description: This amplifier features two 60‑watt channels and offers several configuration options. You can use it as a normal 60‑watts/channel stereo amplifier, as two separate 60‑watt mono amplifiers, or as a single bridged 120‑watt mono amplifier. It includes both unbalanced line level stereo RCA inputs as well as balanced Euroblock connector inputs for use as line or microphone inputs. It has independent volume controls for each channel, as well as bass and treble tone controls and an switchable amplifier limiter circuit. In stereo or dual mono mode it supports 4‑ohm and 8‑ohm loads, or an 8‑ohm load for bridged mono operation.Features: Can be configured for 60‑watts/channel stereo, dual 60‑watt mono, or bridged 120‑watt mono modesTwo balanced mono inputs using Euroblock connectorsTwo unbalanced line level stereo RCA inputsMic/Line switch for the balanced inputsSeparate volume controls for each inputSwitchable amplifier limiter to prevent clippingSupport Files: User's Manual (Jan 9, 2017)Small Retail Sales Sheet (Apr 24, 2017)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
